title: Lecture → LLM Architecture Overview
extracted_text: After learning about the attention mechanism, let us understand the LLM architecture
diagram_summary: Three-stage LLM development pipeline: Stage 1 shows building an LLM from data preparation and sampling through attention mechanisms; Stage 2 shows foundation model development with training loop, model evaluation, and preprocessing; Stage 3 shows applications including classifier and personal assistant with instruction dataset and finetuning.
